Downloaded this software to get access to DisplayCal for MacOS after the link to DisplayCal was damaged. After several prompts to upgrade TeraBox downloaded the 103MB file at ~72kb/sec. 

When complete the software was corrupt and couldn’t be opened. Not even a prompt from Privacy & Security to open it anyway.

Stay far from this. Probably full of malware at a minimum. Rebooting from disconnected backup now to wipe the internal drive on my Studio and restore via CCC.

reviews.title: STAY FAR, FAR AWAY. SO MANY RED FLAGS.
reviews.text:
This is Flextech Inc. out of Tokyo, formerly Dubox by Baidu. Neither the terms of service nor the privacy policy mentions Baidu once. That is a choice. And it sets the tone for everything below.

Before you can even reach the terms and privacy policy links, the app puts its tracking permission demand in front of you. You're asked to consent to surveillance before you're allowed to read what you'd be consenting to. That's the handshake. Here's what's actually in the documents:

1. They profile your files. The privacy policy has you agreeing they can aggregate and analyze your information to build "label information" reflecting your "operation habits, interests, or credit," then use it for automated decision-making and marketing. A storage locker that opens your boxes and scores you.

2. The app reads your clipboard. It's a declared feature, supposedly only for invite codes and share links, with a promise they'll never look otherwise. Your clipboard carries passwords, 2FA codes, banking details, crypto seed phrases. Weigh that promise against a company that won't print its own corporate history.

3. Deletion is discretionary. You email a helpdesk, they "determine whether to accept your deletion request based on your usage," and if you have any data in your account they won't accept it immediately. No timeline given. It's a storage service. Having data in the account is the entire product. The deletion right functions mainly for empty accounts.

reviews.text: Right after I upgraded to Premium, the app automatically enabled the Auto Backup feature without my explicit consent. This is a severe violation of user privacy and a breach of data control. To make matters worse, the original high-quality files on my device storage disappeared, while the versions backed up in your cloud turned out to be compressed and blurry. Real premium apps like Google Photos always wait for explicit user confirmation before backing up or touching local data. Forcing a backup and ruining important data without confirmation is unacceptable and highly damaging to users.

reviews.title: You’re all fools.
reviews.text:
All you dummies and dinguses giving 5 stars…saying things like, “it’s great for important documents”…is it? what kind of documents? are you keeping your bank info in there? maybe social security deets? why would you keep important documents in a “free” storage  platform that you clearly haven’t researched? terabox (formerly “dubox”) was originally owned by baidu (a chinese giant) before getting renamed and now claims to be run by “flextech” based in tokyo, yet there’s really no information anywhere about “flextech” so it seems to just…exist on paper, while the servers, tech stack, whole operation traces back to baidu in china. something interesting to consider here is that japan has different privacy laws than china. basically, japan = privacy-friendly, china is not (see: tiktok)…would china slap a shell company on an unassuming, new, shady little app to fake safety? and why would they do that?? that’s for you to decide… 

or, y’know, not… because you’re all just blindly trusting a random app off the bat and throwing all your “important documents” in without even thinking about security/privacy at all, apparently.

reviews.title: Too much ads
reviews.text:
Too much ads in the free version of the application, The app has become extremely difficult to use due to aggressive ads. Every minute or so, the app forces Safari to open with ads, without giving me any chance to cancel or block them. When I close Safari and return to the app, it immediately redirects me back to the same ad, creating an endless loop. This behavior is not normal for an iOS app and makes the entire experience frustrating and unusable.

I’ve tried clearing data, reinstalling, and adjusting settings, but the issue continues. Please investigate and fix this problem as soon as possible. The service itself is good, but the current ad behavior is unacceptable.

reviews.text:
Even with the paid Premium version, it is not possible to select several files at once to download that are backed up on the drive. You already have to click one by one, it takes time and is very inconvenient.
It is also complicated that when the photos are downloaded, they are not in full resolution and the download process itself is complicated.
